newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.

text.p: heifers were steady, compared to Monday, USDA said.

Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 5 percent cows and bulls, 30 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs. Receipts - 335 Last Week - 95 Last Year - 365

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 500-600 lbs 70.25-80.00, two pkgs 82.50, replacement quality 85.00-87.00; 600-700 lbs 73.00-76.25, two pkgs replacement quality 84.00-85.00; few 700-825 lbs 69.00-72.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - pkg 300 lbs 80.25; few 550-850 lbs 57.50-59.50.
